description: Answer a question with sources: search the web, read the best pages, synthesize a short answer that cites them. No files are changed. Исследует вопрос в интернете и отвечает со ссылками.

nodes.instruction: Search the web for the question.

Question: {{task}}
Read the most relevant of the search results (read_webpage) and answer the question. State only what the sources say; if they disagree or do not answer, say so. Answer with the JSON object: answer=<short answer>, sources=<the URLs you used, one per line>, confident=true or false.
